plan: Model the check-in state as a single session dictionary with exactly the four contract keys, reset from a shared initial template by begin and abandon.

Dispatch handle(action) through a type-to-handler table; each handler validates all preconditions and payload fields before any mutation, returning an Error: screen on failure so accepted data is never corrupted.
Build every screen through one _screen helper that fixes the {prompt, messages, choices} shape and includes copied appointment choices exactly when the prompt is 'Choose appointment'.

Derive prompts from state with a _next_prompt function (contact unmet -> 'Confirm contact', appointment unmet -> 'Choose appointment', else 'Review and complete'), reused for corrections and for deterministic error screens.

Treat action_source and screen_sink as injected duck-typed ports; run_once raises RuntimeError before calling either when one is missing, otherwise reads one action, handles it, displays the screen exactly once, and returns that same object.
Copy the appointments sequence at construction so external mutation cannot affect emitted choices.
mechanisms: single mutable session record with template reset
guard-then-mutate action handlers with dispatch table
centralized screen constructor enforcing fixed shape and conditional choices
injected source/sink ports validated before use in run_once
